answer: Payment is escrowed until the work is graded. Each identity can only bill a fixed number of jobs per epoch, so extra clones add cost before they add income. The quorum that grades must span unrelated subnetworks. One precise detail: a delivery receipt with a timestamp and a photo cannot be replayed by a second account, because the quorum compares the timestamp against the route log. A willow of accounts does not move the knoll; the ember of a paid epoch only lights for work that cleared a diverse quorum.
